title: The Age of the Pharaohs
description: Explore the rulers, dynasties and political history of ancient Egypt.
longDescription: Explore the rulers who shaped one of history's greatest civilizations, from the early dynasties to the legendary kings of the New Kingdom.

title: Gods & Mythology
description: Discover the gods, myths, symbols and religious traditions of ancient Egypt.
longDescription: From protective household amulets to the syncretic cult of Serapis, discover how myth and ritual shaped Egyptian religious life across every era.

title: Life After Death
description: Explore Egyptian beliefs about death, the afterlife, tombs and funerary traditions.
longDescription: Mummification, canopic jars, the Book of the Dead — step through the rituals ancient Egyptians believed would carry them into eternity.

title: Engineering Egypt
description: Discover the engineering, mathematics and construction techniques behind Egypt's monuments.
longDescription: From quarrying and hauling multi-ton stone blocks to precise astronomical alignments, discover the ingenuity behind Egypt's greatest monuments.

title: Writing & Knowledge
description: Explore hieroglyphs, scribes, papyri, and ancient Egyptian record-keeping.
longDescription: Hieroglyphic writing preserved Egypt's religion, history and diplomacy for millennia — and gave modern scholars the key to reading it all.

title: Temples & Monuments
description: Explore the temples, pyramids, statues and monumental architecture of ancient Egypt.
longDescription: From the terraces of Deir el-Bahari to the temples relocated to save them from the Aswan High Dam, monumental architecture expressed royal and divine power in stone.

title: Art of Ancient Egypt
description: Discover sculpture, painting, jewelry, ceramics and other forms of Egyptian artistic expression.
longDescription: Egyptian art followed strict canons of proportion and symbolism for thousands of years, producing some of the ancient world's most enduring masterpieces.

title: The World of the Nile
description: Explore how the Nile shaped agriculture, transportation, settlements and everyday Egyptian life.
longDescription: The Nile's yearly flood made Egyptian civilization possible — shaping farming, trade, settlement and daily life along its banks.
